{{Quote|Senator Organa! My clone troops turned on me&hellip; I need help.''"<br />"''We have just rescued Master Yoda. It appears this ambush has happened everywhere. We're sending you our coordinates.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]|<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
The '''''Sundered Heart''''' was a [[CR70 corvette/Legends|CR70 corvette]] used by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] around the time of the [[Declaration of a New Order]]. It was later [[Vanguard c20 retrofit suite|heavily modified]] and converted into a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Sundered Heart'' was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Captain Antilles, report to the bridge immediately.|An announcer aboard the ''Sundered Heart''|<ref name="Memory Loss">{{SWComicCite|7.13|Memory Loss}}</ref>}}
[[File:Sundered_Heart_droid_workshop.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The droid workshop aboard the ''Sundered Heart'']]
The ''Sundered Heart'' had a very small [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]] which could house one or two [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], depending on size. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] utilized this bay when he rendezvoused with the ''Sundered Heart'' after his [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|battle]] against [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref name="ROTS" />

The ''Sundered Heart'' also had a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] workshop where [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] memory was [[Memory wipe/Legends|erased]].<ref name="Memory Loss" />

After its [[Vanguard c20 retrofit suite|transformation]] into a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] added fins and extra [[Engine/Legends|engine]] compartments allowed it to move almost four times faster than a standard [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]]. The ''Sundered Heart'' also carried special equipment that allowed it to weaken enemy fire on command by creating an energy flux.

==History==
===Rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|I'm placing these droids in your care. Treat them well. Clean them up. Have the protocol droid's mind wiped.|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] to [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]]|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
[[File:SunderedHeart-RotS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Sundered Heart'' near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] would use the ''Sundered Heart'' as his personal [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], often utilizing it to travel from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. After witnessing firsthand the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attack]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], Senator Organa departed Coruscant in an attempt to rescue as many of the few survivors of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi Purge]] as he could. Using a stolen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]], Organa was able to contact and rescue two of the last surviving members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had escaped the [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] attacks on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref name="ROTS" />

Organa later took the ''Sundered Heart'' back to Coruscant so Yoda and Kenobi could alter a [[Jedi beacon/Legends|Jedi beacon]] at the Jedi Temple, to keep the rest of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] safe. At the same time, Senator Organa's presence was requested at the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] for the [[Declaration of a New Order]]. Afterward, Organa saved Yoda from a [[Skirmish in the Senate|duel in the Senate Chamber]], after Yoda lost to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="ROTS" />

[[File:SunderedHeartConferenceRoom-SithSnapshots.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The conference room in the ''Sundered Heart'']]
Later, the ''Sundered Heart'' traveled to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] with the body of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who had [[Death/Legends|died]] on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] shortly after the birth of her twins. It was aboard the ''Sundered Heart'' that the fates of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] were decided. The [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] would adopt Leia on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars family]] would adopt Luke on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Yoda claimed to Kenobi that he had encountered the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], and said that Jinn would be training Kenobi and Yoda in their exiles. Organa then ordered [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] memory to be [[Memory wipe/Legends|erased]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]], to keep the locations of the twins a secret. Yoda left the vessel for his self-exile to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] via his [[E3-standard starship lifeboat/Legends|escape pod]], and Kenobi left as well for his self-exile to Tatooine. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and C-3PO were assigned to the ship at this point.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Imperial Period===
{{Quote|We have to cause as much destruction as we can. And be quick about it. Threepio?''"<br />"''Yes, sir?''"<br />"''Have Artoo monitor Imperial comm channels and scan for any chatter about our mission.|[[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="EaW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>}}
At some point, the ''Sundered Heart'' was modified with the [[Vanguard c20 retrofit suite]], converting from a [[CR70 corvette/Legends|CR70 corvette]] to a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], as well as adding a more powerful [[Engine/Legends|engine]] bank than standard.

Captain Raymus Antilles received the ship as a gift for running aid and medical supplies past several [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] blockades.<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Under Antilles, the ship participated in the [[Space Battle at Kuat|battle]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], where it destroyed six Imperial [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], in order to begin the [[Fresian campaign|operation]] of stealing the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] prototypes. The ''Sundered Heart'' also [[Space Battle in the Kessel Asteroid Field|rescued]] many [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] as they were being transported to the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. Later, the ship participated in the [[Battle at Atzerri|battle]] of [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]].

During [[Operation Skyhook]], and since he was in an official task, Raymus Antilles piloted the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], rather than the ''Sundered Heart''. The ''Tantive IV'' was captured during the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|battle of Tatooine]], and Raymus Antilles was killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Our friend within the Senate is following her leads as we speak. She may be able to provide us detailed schematics of the Death Star, but will need a reliable captain for some errands that may put her at risk.''"<br />"''I'll transfer to her ship immediately. Threepio, Artoo, come along. We'll need you too.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]]|<ref name="EaW" />}}
The ''Sundered Heart'' was first introduced in the 2006 game ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'', as a hero unit for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In 2010, [[Leland Chee]] confirmed a [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] that [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] ship from [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] was indeed the ''Sundered Heart'', and not the ''[[Tantive IV]]'', as was previously established.<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?messageID=17923716#17923653|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2010-08-07|time=2:30 AM}}</ref>
